svg.text: Bash script: parses flags and commands,
shows numbered menus if arguments are missing,
asks y/N before restore, delete and drop,
Unix socket works without a file
Dump one or all databases to .sql.gz
Load a dump (original or new name)
Delete dumps older than retention days
Live databases, or tables of one database
Environment variables: BACKUP_DIR, RETENTION_DAYS, LOG_FILE, CREDS_FILE
Priority: flag, then environment variable, then built-in default.
Requirements: Linux with Bash, MariaDB, gzip, find, sudo;
systemd only for the automatic daily backup.
- Flags must come before the command.
- restore removes CREATE DATABASE / USE lines,
- Restoring all-databases_* asks for no name;
- Dumps stay on the same server; copy them
